name: X-cube loop connection criteria
definition: Criteria to decide how to connect remaining free loops within X-cubes after X-faces are fixed. Connecting two loops results in a net increase of T (triangles) by four (due to Equation 3). Due to T = 2V + 4(H − S), this causes a net increase of (H − S) by one.
summary: X-cube loop connection criteria resolve topological ambiguities within X-cubes by deciding whether to connect free loops, prioritizing mesh simplicity or feature preservation unlike X-face slashing criteria.
